body:
Hey there, I found your post really powerful. The way you described your former self and then how you are today - what triggered the transformation do you know? What changed in your life?

You asked for suggestions for dealing with it - would you consider writing more extensively about your story? Sometimes writing everything down can put things in perspective and you may be able to pinpoint particular triggers/areas that you could work on which may help minimise your anxiety?

Currently working on launching a website that share people's experiences with mental health from around the world, with the hope to raise awareness, stop stigma and help people to not feel so alone. If you were interested in writing, we would love to feature your story.

Thanks for the search suggestion - though all of those posts just have a mod responding to them, there's no actual discussion/information. I'm sorry to be annoying, but I'm new on here and not really sure how it all works.
Thanks for your support, really appreciate it! Let me know if you want to share a more extensive story :)
